resources.string: Forward booking emails to your own HeyGate address
Forward an airline or travel-site booking email to your HeyGate address. We add the flights and send you an alert.
Open a booking confirmation from IndiGo, Air India, MakeMyTrip or any airline in your email app.
Forward it to your address above. PDF tickets work too.
In a minute, the flights appear in HeyGate with alerts turned on.
Only the flight details are kept; the email itself is not stored. Emails that arrive while you are not on Pro are ignored.
Add flights by forwarding an email
Pro gives you a private email address. Forward any booking to it and the flights are tracked for you.
